entries.title: Golf

emulation.emulator: Mesen or puNES for NES primary
emulation.notes: Use accurate NTSC/PAL region settings and integer scaling. Capture Game Boy or arcade branches separately only if comparing ports.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Cycle-accurate NES capture of the original 1984 game

primary.version: Original Famicom/NES cartridge version via accurate NES emulation
primary.why: Golf is Nintendo's 1984 Famicom/NES golf game with arcade, Japanese computer, Game Boy, e-Reader, Virtual Console, Arcade Archives, and Nintendo Switch Online access routes. The Famicom/NES version is the canonical home original and the best primary for accurate capture.
primary.how_to_play: Use a clean Famicom/NES cartridge dump in Mesen, puNES, or another accurate NES emulator. Capture at integer scale with correct NTSC/PAL timing for the chosen region; use other releases only for historical port comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this with Family Computer Golf: Japan Course, Family Computer Golf: U.S. Course, NES Open Tournament Golf, or later Mario Golf games. The 2019 Switch Arcade Archives release is the arcade branch; the 2024 Switch Online entry is the NES branch.
